note: Maps OUR metric names (facts.py) to the standard us-gaap XBRL concept(s) that report them, in priority order (different filers occasionally use a different but equivalent tag; the first one present wins). Deliberately limited to metrics with one clean, near-universal GAAP tag: total debt, free cash flow and most vocabulary-pack metrics have no single canonical tag (debt splits across several line items; free cash flow and pack metrics like AFFO/EBITDA are non-GAAP, not separately standardized in XBRL) and would need per-company judgment a mapping table can't safely automate, so they are left out rather than guessed.
